system: Kaite Tsukutte Asoberu Dezaemon (Super Famicom, Athena 1994, SHVC-66)
note: The Super Famicom sibling of games-db.json. Same seven fields, so one loader reads both; a separate file because that one is a verbatim copy of the satakore Dezaemon 2 (Saturn) table and a Super Famicom cart is not in it. Genre is always a vertical shoot-em-up here: SFC Dezaemon has no horizontal mode — MAP DATA is 18 columns by 128 rows, scrolling up (FORMAT-SFC.md). titleJa/developerJa are null for authors who never published a Japanese name; the editor falls back to the Latin one.
